peers.name: review-animations
peers.description: Reviews animation and motion code against a high craft bar derived from Emil Kowalski's design engineering philosophy. Default to flagging; approval is earned.

peers.name: improve-animations
peers.description: Survey a codebase's animation and motion code as a senior motion advisor, then produce a prioritized audit and self-contained implementation plans for other agents (or cheaper models) to execute. Read-only on source code — it plans improvements, it does not apply them. Use when the user asks to "improve the animations", "audit the motion", "make this app feel better", or wants a roadmap of animation fixes rather than a review of a single diff.

peers.name: find-animation-opportunities
peers.description: Search a codebase or UI for places that don't animate but should, and reject everything that shouldn't. Read-only; it proposes motion with exact values, it does not implement it. Use when the user asks "what could be animated here?" or wants to "make this feel more alive". For fixing existing animations, use improve-animations or review-animations instead.

peers.name: emil-design-eng
peers.description: Emil Kowalski's design-engineering philosophy for UI polish, component design, animation decisions, and the invisible details that make software feel great. Use when building or reviewing a UI component's interactions and polish (press and hover states, popover origin, tooltip timing, transitions vs keyframes, clip-path techniques, drag details) and no narrower skill fits.

en.tagline: Finds and removes animations an interface doesn't need
en.summary: remove-animations audits the motion already in an interface and deletes or reduces the animations that don't earn their place. Each animation passes through a fixed decision tree, and code left unused by a removal is cleaned up. It only subtracts: it never adds motion or retunes easing or springs.
problem: Agents often add motion by default, such as fade-ins on scroll, hover scale on cards, and animated command palettes. Each one looks reasonable alone, but together they can make the product feel slow, especially on surfaces used many times a day.

With this skill, every animation must pass a gate that asks what it is for. Animations triggered by the keyboard, seen very often, or placed on functional data are deleted. Animations that stay are listed with the reason they were kept, and orphaned code is removed.
fit: An app that feels over-animated or slow to respond
Command palettes, menus, tab switches, or list rows with motion on frequent use
Scroll reveals, looping decoration, or charts that redraw on every load
unfit: Adding new motion or changing easing on animations that stay (use improve-animations or review-animations)
Finding places that should animate (use find-animation-opportunities)
steps: Recon: identify the stack, motion libraries, where motion lives, and how often each animated surface is used.
Sweep the codebase for known classes of motion, such as keyboard-triggered menus, hover transforms, scroll reveals, infinite loops, and spinners.
Pass each candidate through the decision tree and record the branch that decided it as delete, reduce, or keep.
Check removal hazards such as hidden start states, code that waits for an animation to end, and layout jumps the animation was hiding.
Apply the deletions and reductions, then remove the keyframes, imports, and wrappers they left unused.
Run the type checker and tests if the project has them, grep for removed names, and report what changed, what was kept, and what needs a check on a real device.

zh.tagline: 找出并删除界面中不必要的动画
zh.summary: remove-animations 检查界面中已有的动效，删除或缩减那些不值得保留的动画。每个动画都会按固定的判断树过一遍，删除后失去用途的代码也会一并清理。它只做减法，不会新增动效，也不会调整缓动或弹簧参数。
problem: 智能体常会默认添加动效，比如滚动时淡入、卡片悬停放大、命令面板带动画打开。每一个单独看都合理，但加在一起，尤其是在每天高频使用的界面上，产品会显得慢。
使用这个 skill 后，每个动画都要先通过一道检查，问它的用途是什么。由键盘触发、高频看到或作用于功能性数据的动画会被删除。保留下来的动画会列出保留的理由，孤立的代码也会被清理。
fit: 感觉动画过多或响应迟缓的应用
命令面板、菜单、标签切换或列表行上高频使用的动效
滚动揭示、循环装饰动画，或每次加载都重绘的图表
unfit: 新增动效，或调整仍保留的动画的缓动（请使用 improve-animations 或 review-animations）
查找应该加动效的位置（请使用 find-animation-opportunities）
steps: 摸底：确定技术栈、动效库、动效所在位置，以及每个有动画的界面被使用的频率。
扫描代码库，查找已知类型的动效，如键盘触发的菜单、悬停变换、滚动揭示、无限循环和加载图标。
让每个候选动画通过判断树，并记录决定其去留的分支：删除、缩减或保留。
检查删除风险，例如隐藏的初始状态、等待动画结束的代码，以及动画原本掩盖的布局跳动。
执行删除和缩减，然后移除它们留下的无用关键帧、导入和包装组件。
如果项目有类型检查和测试，就运行它们，搜索已删除的名称，并报告改动内容、保留内容，以及需要在真机上确认的部分。
